summary: Flexible House of Wisdom civ. Each of its eight wings unlocks a strong bonus at once, and wings bought in later ages are stronger. Desert Raiders and camels give it a mobile army.

spikes.label: Desert Raider pressure
spikes.detail: Desert Raiders arrive in Feudal and can switch between a melee and a ranged weapon, so they raid and skirmish well.
spikes.answer: Keep spearmen and a tower near your gold and wood lines, and avoid chasing raiders into their army.

spikes.label: Camel Lancers and siege
spikes.detail: Camel Lancers and Ghulams form the Castle Age army, backed by Manjaniqs or the Tower of the Sultan to break defenses.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and crossbows hold the camels; send fast units at the siege.

spikes.label: Golden Age and wings
spikes.detail: Wings researched late give their biggest bonus, and the Golden Age keeps their economy ahead late.
spikes.answer: Force fights before Imperial; long passive games favor them.

pairings.why: Fast raiding cavalry with a cheap anti-cavalry screen.
Heavy camels protect siege that out-ranges defenses.

winConditions.detail: Mobile camel and raider army that forces fights across the map.
Golden Age bonuses let them outscale if left alone.
